name: checkin-kiosk-bice
features: Home screen offers walk in or I have a reservation.
Walk in flow takes party size and shows an estimated wait and a ticket.
Reservation lookup finds a booking, confirms it and checks the guest in.
Staff area behind a PIN shows the waiting list, log and reservations with seat, left, undo and no-show.
Staff can add reservations and move between days.
Data loads and saves through the backend API.
